title: Clo Zfab Kit Launch Event Hong Kong
description:
We launched the new CLO zFab Kit in Hong Kong providing hands on live demo and presentations. Our Maximizing Value through Collaborative Data-Driven Solutions presentation emphasized the importance of collaboration among brands, vendors, and suppliers. 

Powered by CLO AI, the CLO zFab Kit empowers brands, vendors, and suppliers to create accurate, high-quality digital representations of fabrics with ease and precision. Learn more: https://zfabkit.clo3d.com/

Questions? Comment below or ask in our CLO discord server: https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/ar...

transcript: How did you feel when you first saw the Z-Fab Kit? We were very much waiting for the Z-Fab Kit. The fabric digitization part, but also the virtual fitting that it can do, and the use of AI, like how Chloé is helping us to explore that, it's very exciting to see. How did you feel when you first saw the Z-Fab Kit? The explanation is very detailed, and I was very patient when I did the demo. The system's feedback from my colleagues was very positive. Compared to the old set, it's a very different improvement. The old set was mainly manual, and a lot of work needed to be done by hand. The new set successfully eliminated the manual operation. In addition, the software is highly automated. There's a lot of auto-generation and tiling, and it's very easy to do. My colleagues are very happy and looking forward to it. The biggest takeaway is that, you know, AI has become such a big topic in the industry, but it's kind of like where to start. So I like that in the presentation, she touched base on what's going to come out and the features, but also like how to start setting it up in the company and actually implement it in the workflow. And then for the fabric scanner, it's really interesting for us as we're always focusing on building our digital material libraries. So to have a more innovative tool to make it more accurate and more usable is very interesting for us. Thank you very much.
summary: # Clo Zfab Kit Launch Event Hong Kong ## Initial Impressions of the Z-Fab Kit How did you feel when you first saw the Z-Fab Kit? We were very much waiting for the Z-Fab Kit, especially for the fabric digitization part. The virtual fitting capabilities it offers, along with the use of AI—like how Chloé is helping us explore that—make it very exciting to see. ## Detailed Explanation and Demo Experience The explanation of the Z-Fab Kit was very detailed, and I was very patient when I did the demo. The system's feedback from my colleagues was very positive. Compared to the old set, it is a significant improvement. ## Improvements Over Previous Systems The old set was mainly manual, requiring a lot of work to be done by hand. The new set successfully eliminates the manual operation. In addition, the software is highly automated with many features such as auto-generation and tiling, making it very easy to use. ## Team Reception and Expectations My colleagues are very happy and looking forward to using the Z-Fab Kit. The biggest takeaway is that AI has become such a big topic in the industry, but it’s often unclear where to start. ## Implementation and Workflow Integration I appreciated that in the presentation, Chloé touched on what features are coming out, but also how to start setting it up in the company and actually implement it in the workflow. ## Fabric Scanner and Digital Material Libraries Regarding the fabric scanner, it’s really interesting for us as we are always focusing on building our digital material libraries. Having a more innovative tool that makes the process more accurate and usable is very valuable for us. ## Closing Thank you very much.
markdown_content: ## Overview of the Z-Fab Kit and Its Impact This section covers initial impressions and key features of the Z-Fab Kit, focusing on fabric digitization, virtual fitting, AI integration, and workflow improvements. It highlights the transition from manual processes to automated systems in fabric scanning and digital material library development. ## Initial Impressions and Experience with the Z-Fab Kit The Z-Fab Kit was highly anticipated for its fabric digitization capabilities and virtual fitting features. Users expressed excitement about the integration of AI, particularly how Chloé (the AI system) aids in exploring these functions. The demo provided a detailed explanation, allowing users to fully understand the system with patience. Feedback from colleagues was very positive, especially when compared to the previous equipment. The old system was largely manual, requiring significant handwork, whereas the new kit eliminates most manual operations. This shift to automation, including auto-generation and tiling processes, makes the software much easier to use and more efficient. ## AI Integration and Workflow Implementation A significant takeaway from the launch was the discussion on AI’s role in the textile industry. AI is increasingly vital but can be challenging to integrate. The presentation addressed key points about upcoming features and practical advice on how companies can begin setting up and implementing AI-driven tools like the Z-Fab Kit into their existing workflows. ## Fabric Scanner and Digital Material Libraries The fabric scanner component of the Z-Fab Kit is particularly valuable for companies focused on building accurate and usable digital material libraries. The innovative scanning technology improves the precision and usability of fabric data, which is essential for digital asset management in fashion and textile industries. Overall, users expressed enthusiasm for the Z-Fab Kit’s potential to enhance digital workflows through automation and AI, marking a significant improvement over previous manual methods.
